prompts.text: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original full-body game character sprite for Pawblossom Puzzle, a cozy hand-painted match-3 game with a cream rabbit hero and softly shaded woodland animals. Create one young beaver who has been busy stacking work crates beside a sunny pond. Character only, with a mildly worried, stubborn-but-kind expression: brows slightly knitted, mouth closed with two small recognizable beaver incisors, bright expressive dark brown eyes. A rounded stocky warm chestnut body, cream muzzle/chest, small rounded ears, short sturdy feet, and a broad flat dark-brown paddle tail clearly visible beside and behind the body on the viewer's right. Both forepaws rest together at the belly; keep limbs separated and readable. A small muted blue neckerchief is the only accessory. Three-quarter view facing slightly left, a balanced standing pose, complete figure. Premium painted storybook material with refined soft 3D volume, gentle fur strokes and clear silhouette readable at 64–96px. Warm daylight from upper left, soft amber edge light, restrained lavender in shadows; a friendly waterside neighbor rather than a frightening enemy. Subject fills about 82% of a square canvas with comfortable transparent margins around every ear, foot and tail tip. Genuinely transparent background, no ground, water, crates, tools, scenery, floor or detached cast shadow. One character only, no sheet, frame, text, logo or watermark. Original design, no resemblance to an existing game character. Intended square 1024 by 1024.
